result.title: Reward Engine: Reward-Centric Self-Evolution for Open-Ended Tool Agents
result.summary: Open-ended tool agents can complete the same objective through different tool paths, and their quality depends jointly on the interaction trace, environment state, and final artifacts, so such tasks rarely admit an executable ground-truth reward. The central challenge is therefore to construct a reward from existing experience that exposes the current policy's failures while remaining stationary during optimization. We introduce Reward Engine, which, like a self-motivated student, first works out what success requires and then optimizes toward it. From the task and initial trajectories, it builds a RewardPack of testcases for required correctness and rubrics for graded quality, each executed as a check that returns a judgment with evidence. The frozen RewardPack then guides the agent to revise and select its outputs, and can also serve as a reward for reinforcement learning. On WorkBuddy Bench Office and Claw-Eval, the constructed reward largely agrees with the benchmark graders, not reversing their ordering on 82.3\% and 80.5\% of candidate pairs. Used to revise executions, it raises three-run consistency ($\mathrm{Pass}^{3}$) over Baseline from 45.0\% to 54.0\% and from 78.4\% to 83.7\%.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Reward Engine：从任务与初始轨迹出发构造由 testcase（正确性检查）和 rubric（分级质量）组成的 RewardPack，冻结后用于指导 agent 修正与选择输出，或作为强化学习奖励，并在两个开放式工具 agent 基准上验证其与基准评分器的一致性及对一致性的提升。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作从已有轨迹中归纳可执行检查与评分标准、并冻结为优化奖励的做法，可能为 latent 推理轨迹的过程监督与贡献分配提供方法线索，可供核查其能否迁移到缺少可执行真值的视觉推理场景。
